verdict.rationale: Cloud Devin runs commands in its own workspace and machine. The docs show a terminal where you can watch commands execute and read output logs, and Devin can build and run apps "on its own machine." It also offers dedicated macOS VMs and Windows session platforms, and configured environments let every session boot into a known-good state. Dependency installation is implied: Devin can reach package registries from inside its workspace (including over VPN) and has environment setup docs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of isolation and security boundaries (sandboxing guarantees, network or permission restrictions), explicit description of dependency installation inside the session, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
